stage_name_zh: 阶段 4：顶会论文、具身智能/生成建模、学术演讲与全周期综合复习（Day 76–116）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 28 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G023】学术标点规范、分号/冒号逻辑功能与逗号粘连（Comma Splice）根治；【G028】学术段落逻辑架构：主题句—机制解释—实证/实例支撑—范围限定。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP023】六级与雅思托福（CET-6 / IELTS / TOEFL）议论文：去模板化“主张—机制—具体实例—让步”结构，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 学术标点规范、分号/冒号逻辑功能与逗号粘连（Comma Splice）根治
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 根治中国学生写作中最普遍的标点语法错误——逗号粘连（Comma Splice，即仅用逗号连接两个独立句子，或把 nevertheless, therefore, however 当连词用逗号连接两句）。
rules: 连接副词（however, therefore, hence, nevertheless, nonetheless, consequently, moreover, furthermore, conversely, likewise）连接两个独立分句时，前句末尾必须用分号（;）或句号（.）！
前置复合修饰语加连字符（a small-scale study, an in-depth analysis, ground-truth labels, blue-collar occupations），后置作表语或状语时不加连字符（examine the issue in depth）。
examples: The observations are dependent; hence, the usual independence assumption does not apply.
The sample is small; nevertheless, the measurements identify a useful question for further study.
common_errors: Comma Splice：*The sample is small, however, the protocol is reproducible（第一个逗号必须改为分号或句号）。

grammar_instruction.name: 学术段落逻辑架构：主题句—机制解释—实证/实例支撑—范围限定
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 无论是顶会论文 Discussion 还是六级/雅思托福主体段，高质量段落都必须具备“清晰主题句（Topic Sentence）-> 作用机制或理论解释（Mechanism/Warrant）-> 具体数据或实例（Concrete Evidence/Instance）-> 边界限定（Qualification）”四层逻辑，拒绝仅靠连接词填空。
rules: 防范逻辑跳跃（Logical Leap）：从“某现象存在或某指标提升”到“应全面推广某政策/模型”之间，必须补充成本、可行性（feasibility）或分布偏移（distribution shift）的权衡（trade-off）。
正确区分对比连接词：on the contrary 仅用于否定刚提及的命题（“恰恰相反”），而对比两个不同群体的表现必须用 by contrast / in contrast / on the other hand。
examples: The report claims that every village was sampled. On the contrary, remote villages were excluded.
Urban use increased; by contrast, rural use remained stable.
common_errors: 把 on the contrary 误当作 on the other hand / by contrast 使用。
段落只有空洞观点句和夸张形容词，缺乏具体机制解释与可核验实例。

grammar_instruction.name: 四大常见表达病灶诊断：口语化、过度表达（Over-expression）、不精确表达与指代悬空
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 针对中国学习者在论文、雅思托福及六级写作中的四大高频失分点建立系统修正机制：(1) 口语化表达混入书面语，(2) 过度表达（语义重复或情态过满），(3) 不精确表达（缺少比较基准、分母或时间单位），(4) 悬空指代。
rules: 修正口语化（Colloquialism）：书面论文中将 a lot of 改为 substantial / a large number of；将 get 改为 obtain / acquire；将 big 改为 substantial / marked；将 do a study 改为 conduct / carry out a study；将 pretty up / dumb down 改为 refine the visual layout / oversimplify。
修正过度表达与语义冗余（Over-expression & Pleonasm）：禁止写 *halve by 50%*（halve 已含 50%）、*mutually collaborate with each other*、*completely eliminate all*、*future forthcoming*。
修正不精确表达（Imprecision）：报告 lag（滞后）、rate（速率）或 relative change（相对变化）时，必须指明采样时间单位（sampling interval）、基线（baseline）与分母（denominator）。
examples:
口语化病句：*We did a small study and got a lot of data, which pretty up our paper.*
修正：*We conducted a pilot study and collected a substantial amount of data to test the protocol.*

不精确病句：*The error dropped by 5%.*
精确修正：*The classification error rate decreased by 5 percentage points (from 20% to 15%) relative to the baseline.*
common_errors: 把口头演讲过渡语（如 *Getting back to the question / That is all very well, but*）直接写进正式期刊论文正文。
混淆相对百分比变化（per cent）与绝对百分点变化（percentage points）。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 六级与雅思托福（CET-6 / IELTS / TOEFL）议论文：去模板化“主张—机制—具体实例—让步”结构
expression_pattern_instruction.template: While [Concession: competing view/cost], [Main Claim: policy/technology] can [Verb: facilitate/mitigate] [Outcome] by [Concrete Mechanism], as illustrated by [Specific Real-World Case].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 专为六级、雅思 Task 2 与托福独立写作设计：告别陈腐套话，用一句话完成让步对比，紧接着给出具体作用机制与可信实例。
examples: While expanding public transport requires substantial infrastructure investment, subsidising bus fares can facilitate access to education for low-income students by reducing daily commuting costs.
Asynchronous online courses allow working adults to study at their own pace; nevertheless, they cannot wholly replace face-to-face seminars that stimulate spontaneous debate.
common_errors: 只写夸张口号（如 *Online education is a double-edged sword and plays a vital role*）而不展开具体原因机制与实例。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 精确区分可数样本量与不可数开销/证据
expression_pattern_instruction.template: While a large number of [plural countable nouns] were collected, the procedure required only a small amount of [uncountable noun].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 在数据集与实验开销描述中准确搭配可数与不可数量词。
examples: A large number of records still require checking.
The protocol requires a small amount of additional information.
common_errors: *a great deal of participants / *an amount of records。
